subject.title: fix(memory-core): avoid cubic MMR similarity rescans

question: Should this PR wait for independently reviewable after-fix runtime evidence once repository inspection is available?
rationale: The supplied performance claims are material to a gateway-liveness fix, but the review environment could not inspect the source or any attached live artifact.

options.title: Require runtime proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted terminal capture, logs, or reproducible timing output showing broad memory search completes after the change.

options.title: Accept body evidence
options.body: Proceed on the contributor’s reported production measurements after a maintainer independently verifies the code path.

recommendation.title: Require runtime proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted terminal capture, logs, or reproducible timing output showing broad memory search completes after the change.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the stated production reproduction and can provide the requested redacted after-fix evidence.
